output.summary: Tall flowering shrub or tree native to coastal and tableland areas of New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. It has dark green, finely divided leaves, golden spherical flower heads and thin, leathery pods. The flowers are eaten in fritters, while edible trunk gum can substitute for gum arabic in fruit jelly.
output.edibilityNote: Flowers are used in fritters; edible trunk gum can substitute for gum arabic, including in fruit jelly.
